title: Canonical fast test runtime, CI tiers and agent rules
goal: Implement the approved testing optimization proposals end to end.
acceptance: Fast test settings are isolated from production.
Pytest is the canonical local and CI runner.
Repeated setup and accidental test collection are reduced.
CI has quality, primary and compatibility tiers.
Agent rules prevent redundant full runs and destructive shared-worktree isolation.
Verification and residual risks are documented.
